entries.title: MaaS Appeal: An Infostealer Rises From The Ashes
entries.description: NOVABLIGHT is a NodeJS infostealer developed and sold as a MaaS offering; it is used primarily to steal credentials and compromise cryptowallets.

entries.title: KongTuke FileFix Leads to New Interlock RAT Variant
entries.description: Researchers from The DFIR Report, in partnership with Proofpoint, have identified a new and resilient variant of the Interlock ransomware group’s remote access trojan (RAT). entries.title: Taking SHELLTER: a commercial evasion framework abused in-the-wild
entries.description: Elastic Security Labs detected the recent emergence of infostealers using an illicitly acquired version of the commercial evasion framework, SHELLTER, to deploy post-exploitation payloads.

entries.title: How AI and contextual search enhance defence cybersecurity
entries.description: Contextual search brings clarity, speed, and insight to defence security teams
